Gold Jewelry Calculator

Enter today's spot price, then the piece details. Buy and sell prices are estimates driven by the spread and labor settings below. Update the spot price and settings to match your own market.

1. Market & Spreads

PAXG is a gold-backed token, 1 PAXG = 1 troy oz of gold, so its USD price tracks spot. Fetched from CoinGecko, no key needed. You can still type a price manually.

Buy offer is what you pay a customer for scrap gold (typically a discount to melt). Retail markup is the margin on top of melt when you sell.
